# `hk config sources`

- **Usage:** `hk config sources`
- **Effect:** read-only

Show the configuration source precedence order

Lists every configuration source from highest to lowest precedence.

## Flags

- **`-h --help`** — Print help

<!-- hk documentation examples -->

## Examples

Show precedence, then inspect the resolved values.

```sh
hk config sources
hk config dump
```
